name: MCP Relay
description: Connect remote MCP clients to your OpenClaw Gateway

cliCommands.name: mcp-relay
cliCommands.description: Inspect the MCP relay connection and manage client grants

relayUrl.label: Relay URL
relayUrl.help: HTTPS relay origin. HTTP is supported only for localhost and 127.0.0.1 development.

controlUiUrl.label: Control UI URL
controlUiUrl.help: Optional HTTPS Control UI URL for direct embedding in ChatGPT. Paths are allowed; credentials, queries, and fragments are not. Configure gateway.controlUi.frameAncestors to allow the embed.

agentId.label: Default Agent
agentId.help: Optional agent for new conversations; otherwise use the Gateway default.
